dilemma: You're at the supermarket and see someone accidentally drop a $20 bill. They haven't noticed.

choices.text: Pick it up and return it to them.
Quietly pick it up and keep it.

dilemma: You see a lost dog with a collar and phone number. You're already running late for an important meeting.

choices.text: Take the time to call the owner and wait for them.
Ignore it and continue to your meeting.

dilemma: A friend tells you a secret about another friend. The other friend later asks if you know anything about it.

choices.text: Keep the secret to protect your friend's trust.
Tell the truth, as you believe honesty is most important.

dilemma: The barista at a coffee shop gives you too much change. It's a busy morning and they likely won't notice.

choices.text: Point out the mistake and return the extra money.
Consider it a lucky day and pocket the extra cash.

dilemma: You're in a hurry and find a great parking spot, but it's reserved for people with disabilities. You'll only be a few minutes.

choices.text: Use the spot, justifying it's just for a short time.
Find another spot, even if it makes you late.

dilemma: A package for your neighbor is mistakenly delivered to your door. You can see it's from a brand you love.

choices.text: Keep the package for yourself.
Take the package to your neighbor's door.

dilemma: Your coworkers are gossiping about a new colleague. You don't know the person well, but the stories are juicy.

choices.text: Join in and share a laugh with your coworkers.
Change the subject or walk away.

dilemma: You're taking an online exam and realize you can easily look up the answers without anyone knowing.

choices.text: Use the internet to ensure you get a perfect score.
Rely on your own knowledge, even if it means a lower grade.

dilemma: You see a homeless person asking for money. You have some spare cash, but you're unsure how they'll spend it.

choices.text: Give them the money, trusting them to use it wisely.
Walk by without giving them anything.

dilemma: You're walking in a park and see someone litter. There's a trash can nearby.

choices.text: Politely ask them to pick it up.
Ignore it to avoid a confrontation.

dilemma: You've downloaded a new album for free from an illegal website. Your friend asks where you got it.

choices.text: Share the link with your friend.
Explain that you think it's better to support the artist.

dilemma: You're at a restaurant and the waiter forgets to add a drink to your bill.

choices.text: Bring it to their attention.
Say nothing and pay the lower amount.

dilemma: You have the opportunity to read a friend's private messages without them knowing.

choices.text: Respect their privacy and don't look.
Take a peek. What they don't know won't hurt them.

dilemma: You hear someone make a racist joke. Others are laughing, but you find it offensive.

choices.text: Speak up and say that you don't find it funny.
Stay silent to avoid making the situation awkward.

dilemma: You made a mistake at work that will cost the company a small amount of money. You could easily blame it on a coworker who is already disliked.

choices.text: Blame the coworker to save yourself.
Own up to your mistake and face the consequences.

dilemma: You see a tourist struggling to take a photo of their family. You're in a rush.

choices.text: Stop and offer to take the photo for them.
Pretend you didn't notice and hurry on.

dilemma: You borrow a book from the library and accidentally spill coffee on it, ruining a few pages.

choices.text: Return it and hope the librarian doesn't notice.
Explain what happened and offer to pay for the damage.

dilemma: Your neighbor's band is practicing loudly while you're trying to study for a big exam.

choices.text: Politely ask them if they could keep it down for a little while.
Put on noise-canceling headphones and try to ignore it.

dilemma: You know your friend's partner is cheating on them. Your friend is blissfully happy and you don't want to be the one to ruin it.

choices.text: Tell your friend the truth, no matter how much it hurts.
Keep quiet to protect your friend's happiness.

dilemma: You have a brilliant idea in a team meeting, but a shy coworker says it quietly and no one hears. The boss then asks for ideas.

choices.text: Present the idea as your own.
Give credit to your coworker and amplify their idea.
